newsitem.title: USA: Birmingham Steel sees Q4 net $0.05/shr.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham Steel sees Q4 net $0.05/shr.

text.p: Birmingham Steel Corp said on Tuesday that charges for start-up losses will reduce its pre-tax earnings for the fourth quarter by $4.5 million, resulting in expected net income of $0.05 per share.
The company said in a news release that operating performance and steel shipments improved during the quarter, but that was offset by the start-up losses and other charges.
Full financial results for the fourth quarter ending June 30 will be released on August 13.
The start-up charges, which will reduce after-tax earnings by $0.09 per share, reflect losses from the new steel scrap processing joint venture with Mitsui & Co Ltd in California.
The charges also reflect start-up losses at the recently formed Birmingham Southeast LLC venture, which includes a re-started melt shop in Cartersville, Ga.
The reorganized Cleveland division is expected to break even in the first quarter of 1998, the company said.
Birmingham said it expects its new scrap processing joint ventures in California and Vancouver, B.C., to contribute to earnings in fiscal year 1998.
